games.name: HOUR 12 🕛 [ANOMALY]
games.desc:
💤You fell asleep at your desk. It's late. Time to go home. 

⏰HOUR 12 is a first-person anomaly horror game set in an endless 1970s office. 

Every room should look exactly like the last one. If it does, keep walking through the EXIT. If anything is different — turn around and go back through the door you came in.

Every right call moves the clock forward an hour. 
A wrong one sends you back to 1:00. 
Reach 12 and you can clock out.

• 100+ anomalies to discover
• Single player & CO-OP modes. 
• An 'endless' mode unlocks after your first shift.
• Headphones recommended.

Inspired The Exit 8 style anomaly games.
